remediation_action: Add exclusion rules to .forceignore or create scoped package.xml omitting quarantined components

root_cause: No .forceignore exists in the POC project root directory to prevent unwanted file deployment

title: Missing Deployment Manifest (package.xml)
root_cause: No manifest/package.xml exists defining the authorized deployment boundary
